_comment: JSON has no comments, so this file uses '_comment' string fields. The example schedule server ignores items whose id starts with '_' or that have "disabled": true. Remove "disabled" (or set it to false) to opt in to recording a public stream. Relative fields startOffsetSeconds / endOffsetSeconds are converted to absolute RFC3339 start / end relative to the server start; absolute start / end values pass through unchanged.
